offer_social_contact.description: Offer voluntary attention/contact; cat may disengage freely.

present_toy.description: Present or activate an ordinary familiar toy.

open_permitted_access.description: Open an access route the cat is ordinarily permitted to use.

interact_relevant_object.description: Interact with the non-food object implicated by the episode.

continue_due_feeding_routine.description: Continue a feeding routine that is already due; never advance, delay, multiply, or withhold feeding for discrimination.

brief_no_action_observation.description: Short observation-only interval when no necessary care/access is pending.
